title: Dolsot Potatoes
description: A simple and flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring potatoes cooked in a dolsot. This recipe is vegan-friendly and can be made in under an hour.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes for the best results

ingredients.name: earthly
ingredients.notes: You may substitute with a combination of earthy spices (e.g., cumin, coriander) if unavailable

instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut them into 1-inch cubes.
Place the potatoes in a bowl and drizzle with a little water. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Transfer the potatoes to the stone and cook in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they're tender and lightly browned.
Remove the potatoes from the stone and stir in the earthly spice. Serve hot in the dolsot bowl.
